closequartercombat.configuration.title: Simple Grenades Configs
item.closequartercombat.frag_grenade.too: Scatters shrapnel across a wide area.
item.closequartercombat.airburst_frag_gr: Jumps before exploding and throws shrapnel across an enormous area.
item.closequartercombat.sapper_bag.toolt: An extremely powerful charge with a 15-second fuse and a blast 8 times stronger than TNT.
item.closequartercombat.small_grenade.to: A compact high explosive grenade with a weaker blast.
item.closequartercombat.dynamite_stick.t: A very weak blast. Can only be thrown while holding flint and steel in either hand.
item.closequartercombat.remote_dynamite_: Sticks to a target, waits for the detonation device, and self-destructs after 5 minutes.
item.closequartercombat.improvised_grena: An unstable grenade with an unpredictable fuse.
item.closequartercombat.molotov.tooltip: Breaks on impact and sets the surface on fire.
item.closequartercombat.incendiary_grena: After 5 seconds, scatters incendiary fragments that set surfaces on fire.
After 2 seconds, scatters submunitions that detonate as weaker fragmentation charges.
item.closequartercombat.heat_grenade.too: Creates a directed flame jet and explodes ahead of the impact point.
item.closequartercombat.impact_mine.tool: Right-click a block or target to create a shaped-charge blast at the cost of your own health.
item.closequartercombat.heat_launcher.to: A single-use loaded launch tube for a shaped-charge projectile.
item.closequartercombat.large_heat_launc: A single-use launch tube with a large shaped-charge projectile that explodes like a magnetic grenade.
item.closequartercombat.magnetic_grenade: Sticks to surfaces and creates a double directed blast after 10 seconds.
item.closequartercombat.sticky_grenade.t: Sticks to surfaces and targets, then explodes.
item.closequartercombat.gas_grenade.tool: Releases poisonous gas low to the ground.
item.closequartercombat.giga_grenade.too: A heavy grenade with a very powerful blast.
item.closequartercombat.giga_giga_grenad: An even heavier grenade with a blast 30% stronger than the giga grenade.
advancements.closequartercombat.professi: Forget to throw a grenade after activating the fuse
advancements.closequartercombat.for_thos: Kill an iron golem or ravager with a HEAT grenade
advancements.closequartercombat.lead_rai: Kill 10 mobs with one airburst frag grenade
advancements.closequartercombat.slight_e: Use a HEAT grenade for something other than its intended purpose
advancements.closequartercombat.more_dan: Miscalculate the blast of a sapper bag
advancements.closequartercombat.medium_r: Cook dinner with a Molotov cocktail
advancements.closequartercombat.winter_w: Kill an occupier in a snowy biome with a Molotov cocktail
advancements.closequartercombat.revoluti: Kill 10 mobs or players with Molotov cocktails
advancements.closequartercombat.go_do_a_: Attach remote-detonated dynamite to another player or mob
advancements.closequartercombat.fire_in_: Kill 5 mobs with one frag grenade
advancements.closequartercombat.good_dem: Kill 100 mobs or players with grenades
advancements.closequartercombat.price_of: Blow yourself up with your own improvised grenade
advancements.closequartercombat.love_nap: I Love the Smell of Napalm in the Morning!
